message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later some days. I make a cup of tea and have some toast, then feed the cat before leaving. I take the bus to work, so I leave home about half an hour before my shift starts. I work part time in a bookshop, so I don’t get there too early. Most days I walk with a colleague to open the shop. I try to keep things routine because that seems to help me feel more stable. Sometimes I hear a voice when I’m alone, but that doesn’t happen every day.
